role: WB Games Software Engineering Co-op: Needham, MA - January-May 2027
jd:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance. 

 Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.
 
Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

 If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

Warner Bros. Games Boston is a Warner Bros. Games development studio focused on creating free-to-play games for mobile platforms. The studio is utilizing its extensive expertise in creating persistent online worlds that foster powerful social gaming communities to develop its hit mobile game, Game of Thrones: Conquest. ㅤ

 WB Games Software Engineering Co-op: Needham, MA - January-May 2027 

 Application Deadline: On or before Monday November 23 
 *please note applications may close early due to applicant volume 

 This co-op will be located in the Needham, MA area. The selected co-op will be expected to join us in the office on a regular cadence based on the manager’s in-office schedule.

 Your New Role 
 As a game client engineer coop, you'll be working on a cross-discipline team fixing bugs and building features for WBG Boston's mobile games, primarily using Unity and C#. A typical day can involve a wide range of problems such as building systems that communicate with the server, processing and displaying player data, creating UI panels that drive gameplay, and working with artists and designers to bring concepts to life. Co-ops will also participate in code reviews and receive mentorship from experienced engineers. In addition to Unity and C#, some other tools commonly used are Git, Json, GRPC, protobuf.  

 Your Role Accountabilities 
 
• Develop and refine gameplay systems to support our mobile game client (Android/iOS). This may include bug fixing, optimization, UI improvements and building new systems, and may be on your own with team assistance or as part of a bigger team effort. 
• Some previous systems developed by interns include: 
• Our Alternate Splash Screen system, which lets the studio customize the loading experience according to events that are run in-game. 
• Our notification overlay system, letting players customize what game information they want to receive. 
• Our trinket template system, letting players quickly craft better gear. 
• Own your work when given prioritized goals and objectives. 
• Work closely with other team members and take technical and professional feedback. 
 Qualifications & Experience 
 
• Comfort with basic software development including coding, knowledge of data structures, algorithms, and complexity analysis 
• Experience programming in C# or another object-oriented language 
• The ability to work in a collaborative environment and effectively communicate with both technical and non-technical team members 
• Curiosity, an open mind, and a willingness to learn and take feedback 
• Experience with Git or other revision control systems 
• Familiarity with the Game of Thrones television series and/or series of books 
• Experience developing for iOS/Android 
• Experience with third party game engines (Unity is preferred) 
• Must be actively enrolled in an accredited college or university degree program in Computer Science, Finance, Economics, Data Science, Business, or related field for the full duration of the co-op (proof of enrollment required) 
• Must be a rising Junior or Senior Student (18 years or older) 
• Must be in academic good standing (3.0 or above GPA). A transcript will be required to verify your GPA if an offer is extended.  
• Skydance will only consider candidates who are presently authorized to work for any employer in the United States and who will not require work visa sponsorship from Skydance now or in the future in order to retain their authorization to work in the United States. Candidates currently on any student or exchange visa, including F-1 CPT, F-1 OPT, J-1, M-1, etc., will not be eligible for the internship program. 
 What to know before applying: 
 
• The duration of the Spring 2027 co-op program is 5 months from January to May dependent on the student’s availability based on the semester schedule.  
• Co-ops will be expected to work 35-40 hours per week in-office for the full duration of the program.  
• Our internships are paid opportunities with a competitive hourly wage. Credit is not required; however, we will provide the necessary documentation for school credit if desired. Relocation is not provided.  
• A Skydance team member will contact you if your experiences and interests match an open internship position. Due to the high volume of applications, we are unable to give individual status updates. 
 About Our Program 
 Skydance's WB Games Co-op Program is designed to nurture students professionally and personally. We attract the country’s boldest and brightest students for paid, for-credit, real-world internship experiences in the entertainment, tech, sports, news and media industries. We offer career-defining opportunities to learn valuable skills that will help you prepare for a successful future.  

 Ready to learn more? Here’s what we offer: 
 
• Hands-on work with passionate, talented team members in your field 
• Mentorship from some of the industry’s kindest and most passionate entertainment veterans 
• Engaging events including professional development seminars, panels with recruiters and former interns, intern-exclusive events, and so much more  
• Access to top-level executives and employees through our Speaker Series and Roundtables 
• Incredible networking opportunities with industry-leading professionals and a robust intern alumni network 
• A creative, collaborative, and inclusive company culture  
 What you can expect to take away from the semester: 
 
• Opportunities to develop professionally and uncover skills you didn’t know you had 
• The insider scoop on the entertainment industry and what happens behind the scenes 
• Relationships that will go beyond your collegiate career 
• Real-life experiences that will provide you with the confidence to delve into your next adventure   
 In compliance with local law, we are disclosing compensation for roles in locations where legally required. Pay Rate: $31 per hour USD for undergrad interns . 

 About Skydance 
 Skydance is a next-generation global media and entertainment company, comprised of three business segments: Studios, Direct-to-Consumer, and TV Media. Skydance's portfolio unites legendary brands, including Paramount, Warner Bros., HBO and HBO Max, Paramount+, Pluto TV, CBS, CNN, CBS Sports, TNT Sports, Nickelodeon, Cartoon Network, MTV, Food Network, BET, HGTV, and Comedy Central.
 
 Some Important Details 
 We embrace the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects a wide array of perspectives, backgrounds and experiences. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take seriously our responsibility to consider qualified candidates on the basis of merit. In line with the laws of the country or region in which the role is based, this includes consideration without regard to race, color, ethnicity, national origin, citizenship status, religion or belief, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, pregnancy, parenthood, physical or mental disability, genetic information, military or protected veteran status, union status or any other category protected by applicable law.

 If you’re a qualified candidate with a disability and you require adjustments or accommodations during the job application and/or recruitment process, please visit our accessibility page for instructions to submit your request.

role: Software Development Engineer Intern, Annapurna Labs - 2027
jd:
At Amazon, our tech isn't just a tool, it's your playground. Our engineers work on scalable systems, cloud services, and customer-facing products that operate at global scale. This is an environment where you learn by building. Whether you're creating cloud-native solutions, optimizing machine learning models, or building products that drive experiences for millions of customers around the globe, your work reaches the world, fast. You'll take ownership early, collaborate across teams and disciplines, and grow your skills as you tackle new problems. There's no single path forward here, with a chance to explore different directions and shape your journey as you go. This is where ambition meets opportunity and, where the impact of what you build helps define what comes next, for customers and for you. 

What's in it for you? An internship at Amazon means real responsibility from day one. You'll build, test, and learn alongside people who want to see you succeed, while making an impact that reaches far beyond campus. 

About the team
Annapurna Labs designs the custom silicon at Amazon - including Graviton (our server processors), Trainium and Inferentia (our machine learning training and inference accelerators), and the Nitro system that powers modern EC2. We own the full stack, from silicon through the software that makes it work (compilers, runtimes, drivers, and the frameworks that let customers run workloads on our hardware). As a Software Development Engineer Intern, you'll write the software that turns custom silicon into products used by millions.

Where you might land:
Annapurna has software teams spanning the full stack, and we work to place you on a technical team aligned with your interests and strengths. Example teams and focus areas include:

 - Compiler development for ML accelerators (Neuron SDK, MLIR, LLVM)
 - ML runtimes and frameworks (integration with PyTorch, JAX, TensorFlow)
 - Low-level systems software, firmware, and device drivers
 - Performance optimization and kernel development for custom silicon
 - Distributed training and inference infrastructure
Once you join, we partner with you and our hiring managers to match you to a team where your background and interests fit best, so your project is something you're genuinely excited to work on.

As an SDE Intern, you'll contribute to real production software, which may include:

 - Designing, implementing, and testing software across the stack - from low-level systems code to compilers, runtimes, and tooling
 - Writing efficient, maintainable code in languages such as C, C++, or Python
 - Optimizing software performance on custom hardware (Graviton, Trainium, Inferentia)
 - Debugging complex issues across the hardware-software boundary
 - Collaborating with hardware, compiler, and systems teams to deliver features end-to-end
 - Documenting your work and presenting results to the team
You'll be paired with a mentor and manager who will scope your project, support your growth, and set you up to deliver meaningful, measurable impact by the end of your internship.
- Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's degree program in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, with a final graduation date of December 2027 or later
- Programming experience in at least one modern language such as C, C++, Java, or Python
- Coursework or project experience in data structures, algorithms, and software design
- Understanding of core computer science fundamentals: operating systems, computer architecture, or systems programming
